mutations.name: a lint step is added that ignores --skip-lint
mutations.comment: Killed only by a DESTRUCTIVE fixture plus a whole-output assertion. An additive fixture gives the linter nothing to say, and a document-only comparison cannot see diagnostics at all.

mutations.name: a lint step is added that honors --skip-lint
mutations.comment: The flag acquiring a real meaning. The no-op claim is only honest while both runs report identically, so honoring the flag must go red too.
